description: Lists Hyperhuman's ready-made template workouts, filtered by length, category, level and plan tier. Use when the user wants stock workouts to start from or browse ideas. Not for the team's own workouts (use list_team_workouts) or guest samples (use list_sample_workouts). Returns template names, IDs, length and level, with paging.

category_ids.description: Workout category IDs from list_workout_categories. Omit for all categories.

difficulty.description: Level: beginner, intermediate or advanced. Omit for all levels.

max_duration_minutes.description: Longest length in minutes, inclusive, e.g. 30. Defaults to no limit.

min_duration_minutes.description: Shortest length in minutes, exclusive, e.g. 10 for over 10 min. Defaults to 0.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

search.description: Text to search names for, e.g. "core". Omit to list everything.

tier.description: Plan tier of the exercises: free, premium, team, or all. Defaults to all.

name: list_workout_templates
title: List workout templates
